integrity: Self-contained symbolic proof and standalone finite checker included; no external dependency is needed for verification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem bounds represented rotation-class sizes only at odd lengths. Sharpness is proved at every length 2^(2j)+1, j>=1, not at every odd length. No closed formula for the odd-length class count or full distribution is claimed. Finite verification supports but does not prove the universal statements. Independent audit and historical-priority verification are outstanding.
title: A sharp three-factor ceiling for odd cyclic classes in the period-doubling word
